subject: MAP & evaluation plan — acceleration request and pricing path
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Jessica Park <jessica@olivetech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + eval plan and pricing for OliveTech pilot

Hi Jessica —

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week. Attached is an updated mutual action plan (MAP_OliveTech_v3.pdf) and a draft SOW for a 3-month evaluation with optional 6-month extension. Highlights:

- MAP milestones: onboarding (week 1), test-run (week 3), model comparisons (weeks 4–6), success criteria review (end of month 3).
- Proposed commercial path: 3-month pilot at list rates with a ramp commitment into a paid pilot-to-production tranche.
- Pricing note: we can offer a milestone-linked rebate (applied as a billing credit) if OliveTech commits to a minimum monthly usage ramp (target: 2.5x by month 3). Exact rebate % to be finalized but we typically route anything >15% through an approval chain.

I included the SOW draft and a pricing_model.xlsx so your procurement team can see assumptions. If you want to accelerate the start (you mentioned early July), let me know what approvals you need internally and I can attempt to fast-track our side.

Attachments: MAP_OliveTech_v3.pdf (MAP), SOW_OliveTech_draft.docx, pricing_model.xlsx (assumptions)

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0124

From: Jessica Park <jessica@olivetech.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP + eval plan and pricing for OliveTech pilot

Mina —

Thanks for the materials. Procurement and I reviewed the MAP and SOW. We like the structure but leadership is pushing for an accelerated kickoff. Two asks from our side if Redwood can accommodate an early July start:

1) A commercial acceleration credit: because this is a cross-team fast-track, can you provide a 20% one-time pilot discount or upfront credit against the first invoice?
2) Firm ramp commitment: we can commit to the ramp targets (2.5x by month 3) and will provide a named POC for integration.

If you can route the 20% discount internally and confirm signatures (VP/CFO/CEO) this week, we can sign and begin onboarding July 6. Please advise what you need.

-jess

Jessica Park
Dir., Product & Integrations | OliveTech
jessica@olivetech.com

To: Jessica Park <jessica@olivetech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + eval plan and pricing for OliveTech pilot

Jessica —

Appreciate the clarity and the ramp commitment — that makes the commercial case much stronger. I'm looping in Ben (sales ops) and Marissa (VP Sales) and Aditya in finance so we can route a formal discount request.

Quick notes:
- The 20% one-time pilot discount is above our standard field-level authority for a pilot rebate; it will require a documented deal_id and CFO/CEO approval for anything >15%.
- If OliveTech can sign a short commitment to the ramp targets and agree to milestone-based billing credits (applied post-milestone), it materially increases the chance of approval.

Ben — can you help assemble a short formal request for finance? I attached the latest pricing_model.xlsx and MAP for reference (HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deals/OLV-1987).

I will coordinate timing on our side — thanks all.

Mina
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: OliveTech — accelerator discount request (formal routing)

Team —

Summary: Mina's prospect (OliveTech) has asked for a 20% one-time pilot discount in exchange for an accelerated July 6 start and a 2.5x usage ramp by month 3. Deal details: related_account=OliveTech, deal_id=DL-2027-0198, expected ARR if converted to committed contract ~ $480k ARR in year 1 (conservative).

Request: Approve a one-time accelerator discount applied to the pilot invoice. Options we can consider:
- Approve full 20% one-time pilot credit (needs CEO + CFO signoff).
- Approve a capped 15% credit now with an additional rebate paid after milestone verification (finance prefers this to limit upfront revenue reduction).
- Approve 12% upfront credit + performance-based incremental credit up to 8% post-ramp (hybrid).

Impact analysis (attached pricing_model.xlsx): net effective price under 20% credit reduces expected cash by ~$18k for the pilot but materially shortens time-to-revenue and increases conversion probability (internal estimate +25% conversion lift).

Attachments: SOW_OliveTech_draft.docx (draft SOW), pricing_model.xlsx

Aditya — please confirm if finance can accept a milestone-tied rebate flow versus a pure upfront credit. Marissa — need VP signoff to route to Marcus for CEO signoff if we go >15%. Mina — please hold client expectation to 15% until we have a green light.

Thanks,
Ben
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 14:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: OliveTech — accelerator discount request (formal routing)

Ben / Marissa —

Thanks for the briefing. A few requirements from finance before I sign off on anything beyond 12% upfront:

1) Documented ramp commitment with measurable KPIs (we need the exact usage baseline and month-by-month targets).
2) Legal to confirm standard SLAs and liability caps in the SOW (no exceptions without legal review).
3) Prefer milestone-tied rebate: 12% upfront credit, with up to +8% payable after verification of ramp at month 3.

If we get the clarified numbers and Legal signs the SOW, I'm comfortable escalating to Marcus for final CEO approval. For now, do not promise 20% to the customer — we can offer the 12% + performance rebate as a compromise.

Aditya Rao
CFO | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: OliveTech — accelerator discount request (CEO decision)

Marissa / Aditya —

I'm comfortable approving a 15% upfront accelerator credit today, contingent on:
- Legal sign-off on the SOW (standard SLAs and caps).
- A documented ramp KPI schedule in the MAP (baseline + month-by-month targets) that Laura will validate with the customer.
- HubSpot tagging and contract clause for milestone verification and rebate clawback in the event of non-performance.

If Legal and Sales Ops confirm, proceed and instruct Mina to share the revised commercial summary with OliveTech and DocuSign link.

Marcus
